title: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.13994v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.

translated_title: BioXArena-Pro：面向自主生物医学机器学习智能体的研究级基准
translated_abstract: 编码智能体越来越多地被提议作为生物医学模型的自主构建者，但现有基准规模小、接近饱和或容易受到信息泄露的影响。我们提出了BioXArena-Pro，这是一个包含来自八个生物医学领域的64个研究级建模任务的基准，每个任务均从已发表的研究中重建而来；大多数任务将完整的生物学单元（如物种或队列）整体保留为测试集。在22种智能体配置中，最佳成绩为100分中的55.1分，且智能体框架的重要性几乎与模型本身相当。我们对每个任务重新运行了已发表的方法：在已发表方法可直接适用的情况下，最佳智能体与这些方法打平；而在重建的任务上，这些方法落后8.2分，这表明智能体通过适应新数据而获益。预训练模型（包括生物基础模型）在最强智能体使用它们的任务上很关键：禁止使用会使该智能体在这些任务上的分数下降9分。每个任务都经过多轮AI辅助审计和最终的人工审查。
tldr: 本文提出BioXArena-Pro基准，包含8个生物医学领域64个经AI辅助审计与人工审查的研究级建模任务，评估显示最佳自主编码智能体仅得55.1/100分，智能体框架与模型同等重要，且智能体通过适应新数据可在重建任务上超越已发表方法8.2分。
en_tdlr: BioXArena-Pro is a research-grade benchmark of 64 audited biomedical modelling tasks across eight domains, on which the best autonomous coding agent scores only 55.1/100, agent scaffolds matter almost as much as models, and agents beat published methods by 8.2 points on rebuilt tasks through adapting to new data.
